Comfort in Vijayawada's heat

Vijayawada summers are among the hottest in the state. We plan orientation, shading, cross-ventilation and heat-reflective finishes so homes stay comfortable and cooling bills stay sensible.

Many homes here host large family gatherings. We design living and dining areas that open up for festivals and feel cosy the rest of the year.
